name: Repaint
long_description:
Repaint is an AI platform for building business websites and web apps.

It is especially good at redesigning existing websites. You can paste in a link to a current site, and Repaint imports its pages, text, and images. From there, you can have it redesign the site in a new style or keep the original design. You can also start a new site from a description.

Beyond the website, Repaint can build online stores, appointment booking, memberships, online courses, and client portals. Payments, customer accounts, and email are built in, so there's no need to connect other services. Every change is made by chatting with the AI.
one_liner: Redesign your website by chatting with AI
